3911.title: Pi custom model discovery investigation
3911.rootCauseOneLine: Actual failure unknown; controlled Pi discovery filters models without configured credentials and performs no HTTP auth probe.
3911.proposedFix: Collect exact versions, selected provider, redacted configuration and error before changing production code.
3911.caveats: Real model inference and any custom ACP adapter were not tested. Repeated diagnostic passed in two clean trusted checkouts.
